name: medfilt2
expr: B = medfilt2(I); B3 = medfilt2(I, [3 3]); B5 = medfilt2(I, [5 5]); e33 = double(isequal(B, B3)); b5c = B5(4,4); b5s = sum(B5(:));
comment: MATLAB medfilt2 — median filter (zero boundary). magic(7) with three spike pixels so the median rejects outliers. Covers: default 3x3, explicit [3 3] (== default, e33=1), and explicit [5 5] neighbourhood (b5c/b5s). Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b (tol=1e-9).
